description: The INSPIRE air transport network of Estonia is a download service run by the Land and Spatial Development Board with data from the national air navigation service provider. Contents: aerodrome nodes, types and categories, aerodrome, runway, apron and taxiway areas, points on runway centrelines, navigation aids, air routes, standard instrument departures and arrivals, instrument approach procedures and airspace areas; on 29 September 2026 the service listed 8 aerodrome nodes and 9 runway areas. Producer: Maa- ja Ruumiamet, from Lennuliiklusteeninduse AS (Estonian Air Navigation Services). Coverage: Estonian aerodromes and airspace, published since 2022. Format and access: INSPIRE WFS and WMS on the national geoportal, with metadata in the national catalogue; the open data portal lists it under CC0. Free. Caveats: the layers follow the INSPIRE schema and aeronautical sources, not an operational aeronautical information product, so they must not be used for navigation; update frequency is irregular. Simulation uses: airport and airspace geometry for airport resilience, obstacle and hazard exposure studies, and linking aviation nodes to ground transport networks. Related records: the Estonian Topographic Database (data-estonia-etak-topographic-database) and the Tartu Airport GNSS jamming case (case_study-tartu-airport-gnss-jamming-2024).
